name: gcloud
description: Official CC Safety Net rulebook for destructive gcloud operations on documented command paths. Curated coverage, not a complete model of the gcloud CLI.
author: cc-safety-net

rules.name: block-gcloud-projects-delete
rules.reason: Deletes a Google Cloud project and everything in it. Recovery is possible only for a limited period. Ask the user to delete projects.

rules.name: block-gcloud-compute-instances-delete
rules.reason: Deletes VM instances and may delete attached disks depending on flags and configuration. Ask the user to delete instances.

rules.name: block-gcloud-storage-rm
rules.reason: Deletes objects, versions, folders, or buckets; recursive mode can remove all versions. Ask the user to delete storage data.

rules.name: block-gcloud-sql-instances-delete
rules.reason: Deletes a Cloud SQL instance and its data. Ask the user to delete database instances.

rules.name: block-gcloud-container-clusters-delete
rules.reason: Deletes a GKE cluster. Ask the user to delete clusters.

rules.name: block-gcloud-kms-keys-versions-destroy
rules.reason: Schedules destruction of a key version, which can make encrypted data permanently unreadable. Ask the user; restore works only before the scheduled destruction.

rules.name: block-gcloud-alpha-projects-delete
rules.reason: Schedules deletion of a Google Cloud project. Some resources can be deleted before the recovery period ends. Ask the user to delete projects.

rules.name: block-gcloud-beta-projects-delete
rules.reason: Schedules deletion of a Google Cloud project. Some resources can be deleted before the recovery period ends. Ask the user to delete projects.

rules.name: block-gcloud-alpha-compute-instances-delete
rules.reason: Deletes VM instances and can delete attached disks according to flags and disk configuration. Ask the user to delete instances.

rules.name: block-gcloud-beta-compute-instances-delete
rules.reason: Deletes VM instances and can delete attached disks according to flags and disk configuration. Ask the user to delete instances.

rules.name: block-gcloud-preview-compute-instances-delete
rules.reason: Deletes VM instances and can delete attached disks according to flags and disk configuration. Ask the user to delete instances.

rules.name: block-gcloud-alpha-storage-rm
rules.reason: Deletes objects, object versions, managed folders, or buckets. Recursive mode removes all object versions. Ask the user to delete storage data.

rules.name: block-gcloud-alpha-sql-instances-delete
rules.reason: Deletes a Cloud SQL instance and its data. A final backup occurs only when requested. Ask the user to delete database instances.

rules.name: block-gcloud-beta-sql-instances-delete
rules.reason: Deletes a Cloud SQL instance and its data. A final backup occurs only when requested. Ask the user to delete database instances.

rules.name: block-gcloud-alpha-container-clusters-delete
rules.reason: Deletes a GKE cluster, its nodes, its running Pods, and some related resources. Ask the user to delete clusters.

rules.name: block-gcloud-beta-container-clusters-delete
rules.reason: Deletes a GKE cluster, its nodes, its running Pods, and some related resources. Ask the user to delete clusters.

rules.name: block-gcloud-alpha-kms-keys-versions-destroy
rules.reason: Schedules destruction of a key version, which can make encrypted data permanently unreadable. Ask the user; restore works only before destruction.

rules.name: block-gcloud-beta-kms-keys-versions-destroy
rules.reason: Schedules destruction of a key version, which can make encrypted data permanently unreadable. Ask the user; restore works only before destruction.

rules.name: block-gcloud-compute-disks-delete
rules.reason: Deletes one or more unattached Compute Engine disks and their data. Ask the user to delete disks.

rules.name: block-gcloud-secrets-versions-destroy
rules.reason: Destroys a secret version immediately by default. With delayed destruction configured, it disables and schedules the version for destruction. Ask the user before destroying secret versions.

rules.name: block-gcloud-storage-buckets-delete
rules.reason: Deletes one or more Cloud Storage buckets. Ask the user to delete buckets.

rules.name: block-gcloud-compute-snapshots-delete
rules.reason: Deletes one or more Compute Engine snapshots that can be needed for recovery. Ask the user to delete snapshots.
